saved to My effects: 'ProjectY_Mangnani_ATTACK_east_Trail' (effect id 0da8d1bf-9df2-4ddc-936a-ebef1f788fd4); open it to tweak with sliders: https://pixellab.ai/create-vfx?effect=0da8d1bf-9df2-4ddc-936a-ebef1f788fd4
128x128, 8 frames @ 12 fps, plays once; anchor (feet) at 64,96
still warns: frames 1, 2 show no effect at all; check life windows and intensity; trail_4 is drawn behind the sprite and 77% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto); fade_4 is drawn behind the sprite and 77% of it is hidden by the sprite: make it reach past the sprite's outline, move it, or put what should show in front (z front; orbits: depth auto). The user gets it as saved: fix it on step e4f32f74-94f3-41a7-b687-0069c2c24539 and export again with --replace 0da8d1bf-9df2-4ddc-936a-ebef1f788fd4, or say why it is right as it is.
download https://api.pixellab.ai/mcp/pixel-tools/4e540eae-8a3c-4f0e-bdb3-8e7a42aafa7b/: projecty-mangnani-attack-east-trail-game.zip, projecty-mangnani-attack-east-trail.gif, projecty-mangnani-attack-east-trail.json, projecty-mangnani-attack-east-trail.png
the game pack: one sheet per piece (the whole effect, behind and in front of the sprite, each part) + manifest.json (what each clip is and where it goes: anchor + offset) + README.txt
image id: 4e540eae-8a3c-4f0e-bdb3-8e7a42aafa7b (its frames, image 1; for pixelart_workbench inspect/edit or save_to_asset)
